This website holds English translated outbreak situation reports for the 2026 Ebola-BVD outbreak.
These are provided by the Centre d'opérations d'urgence de santé publique (COUSP) / L'Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP).

Before sharing this, please cite the original sitrep source:

- [INSP Sitreps](https://insp.cd/ebola-17eme-epidemie/)

Many thanks to those providing public access to the INSP sitreps.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Context & use

This work is an aggregation of public data and we have no involvement in the source data.

The intention here is to provide an English translated, machine-readable, time-stamped archive of public sitrep information and data.

- Sitreps are downloaded from the publicly available [INSP website](https://insp.cd/ebola-17eme-epidemie/)
- Each PDF is transcribed into French markdown with Google Gemini, using this [prompt](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/blob/main/assets/prompt-transcribe.md). The French transcription is the record: it is checked against the numbers in the source PDF, and nothing is translated at this stage
- The French is then translated to English with this [prompt](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/blob/main/assets/prompt-translate.md). Each translated table is checked to hold the same numbers as the French one
- The English pages are rendered here

All data and code is available for re-use, and contributions welcome: [codebase](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps)

We welcome feedback, suggestions, and collaboration: [contribute directly](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/issues) or [get in touch](mailto:katharine.sherratt@lshtm.ac.uk).
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Data archive

- [French transcriptions](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/tree/main/data/corpus/fr), one markdown file per report
- [Data tables](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/tree/main/data/csv), one CSV per table
- [Report manifest](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/blob/main/data/manifest.csv): the source URL and md5 of every PDF
- [Quality checks](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/blob/main/data/corpus-qa.csv): for each report, the share of numbers in the PDF found in the transcription

Tables are extracted automatically. Refer to the source PDF where anything is unclear.

Source PDFs are not stored here. Each report page links its original on the INSP website.
:::

## English-language sitreps

::: {.callout-caution}
- This is an aggregation of public data: we are not affiliated with INSP in any way
- All translation and conversion from PDF including English translation is via Google Gemini AI
  - This is likely to contain errors, mistranslations and could lead to misinterpretations.
    I recommend checking the original source before relying on the automated translation.
  - Please flag if you spot errors or mistranslations
  - Feel free to suggest improvements to the [translation prompt](https://github.com/epiforecasts/bvd-sitreps/blob/main/assets/prompt-translate.md)
- Sitrep PDFs contain contact details for INSP and relevant data owners.
  Please refer to these for data-specific questions.
:::
